Brini Bruni

Privacy

What this feed shows

This feed shows public posts from Brini Bruni’s own Instagram account. It is updated once a day.

What is stored

For each post, the feed keeps the caption, the date, the link to the post on Instagram, and two small thumbnail images. It does not keep full-size photos or videos. It does not collect comments, likes, or anyone else’s posts, and it removes other people’s usernames from captions.

Visitors

This feed collects no data about visitors. It uses no cookies, analytics, or tracking, and its pages load nothing from other websites. The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, and GitHub may keep its own server logs.

Removing a post

If Brini Bruni deletes a post on Instagram, the next daily update removes it here, as long as it is one of the account’s 50 most recent posts. For anything else, or to ask for a post to be removed, email hello@brinibruni.com.

See also: how to request data deletion.
